title: Slate eval fixture metadata
description: meta.json beside a transcript: which case and configuration it belongs to, how the run ended, what the sandbox held afterwards, and, for synthetic fixtures, the verdict the graders must reach.

synthetic.description: True for hand-written transcripts that prove the graders. They never count toward the eval matrix.

artifacts.description: Files under the run's sandbox after it ended, relative to {workdir}.

failed.description: Exactly the check ids that must come out FAIL.

unchecked.description: Exactly the check ids that must come out UNCHECKED (empty when omitted).
